items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: So I played the show and Fess went and sat out in the audience at the Hoffman Theatre

ctx.x: have these special shoes to play in. So I played the show and Fess went and sat out in the audience at the Hoffman Theatre, and told him, "Now that's the way it goes." I said, "Yes but I'm not going to be with you eventually. I'm going back with Basie." But it was a wonderful thing. At that particular time Dannie Barker was contemplating writing -
Dannie Barker, the guitar with us player?
